mobium.name: Mobium
mobium.bench.started: Benchmark %s (%s): warming up for %s s, then recording for %s s
mobium.bench.finished: Benchmark %s (%s): %s frames, avg %s FPS, 1%% low %s FPS, avg %s ms, p95 %s ms
mobium.bench.sections: Average ms per frame: extract %s, submit %s, pose %s, tessellate %s, prepare %s, draw %s
mobium.bench.busy: A benchmark is already running; stop it with /mobium stop
mobium.bench.failed: Could not write the benchmark results: %s
mobium.bench.capped: Frame rate is capped (max framerate %s, VSync %s); set max framerate to Unlimited and VSync off, or the results stop at the cap
mobium.bench.wrong_setup: This instance is meant for setup %s, but %s is active: select the shader pack (Video Settings → Shader Packs) or enable Fresh Animations (Resource Packs) as docs/benchmarks.md says, or remove -Dmobium.bench.expect from the instance's Java arguments
mobium.bench.on_battery: Running on battery: results are not comparable, plug in the power supply
mobium.bench.low_power: Power profile is %s: results are not comparable, switch to Balanced or Performance
mobium.bench.resolution: The window is %s instead of %s (display: %s); move the fullscreen window to a 1920×1080 monitor
mobium.suite.started: Benchmark suite: %s scenes × %s runs of %s s, about %s min. Do not touch the game until it reports the medians.
mobium.suite.gatea_started: Gate A: storage_room, %s runs of %s s each with the static cache off and on, about %s min. Do not touch the game.
mobium.suite.gatea_result: Gate A: %s× faster with the static cache (target %s×): %s
mobium.suite.singleplayer: The benchmark suite only runs in a singleplayer world
mobium.suite.no_datapack: The mobium-bench datapack is not enabled in this world
mobium.suite.timeout: scene %s was not ready after %s s
mobium.suite.not_quiet: Scene %s was still busy after %s s (section rebuilds, light or server load); measuring anyway, results may be noisy
key.mobium.ab_toggle: Switch Mobium off and on (A/B comparison)
mobium.ab.vanilla: Mobium: off, everything takes the vanilla path (A/B key %s)
mobium.toast.failed.title: Mobium switched a module off
mobium.toast.failed.message: %s hit an error; vanilla draws instead until restart. Details are in the log.
mobium.settings.title: Mobium
mobium.settings.enabled.tooltip: Switches every module. Off means everything is drawn exactly as without Mobium.
mobium.settings.module_enabled.tooltip: Switches this module. Off means vanilla draws what it would handle.
mobium.settings.memory_budget.tooltip: How much GPU memory the static cache may use; above it, the farthest objects go back to the vanilla path.
mobium.settings.lod_preset.tooltip: Far or tiny mobs reuse last frame's pose. Off by default.
mobium.sodium.all_settings.tooltip: Opens Mobium's own settings screen, which also shows which modules are active and why the others are not.
mobium.suite.gatea_unavailable: Gate A needs the static cache, which cannot run: %s
mobium.suite.gateb_started: Gate B: %s rounds of storage_room with the static cache, control with it and control without it, %s s each, about %s min. Do not touch the game.
mobium.suite.gateb_result: Gate B: storage_room %s× control (target at most %s×): %s; control with the cache %s× without it: %s
mobium.suite.gateb_unavailable: Gate B needs the static cache, which cannot run: %s
mobium.debug.unknown_module: Unknown module; use static_cache, part_transform or animation_lod
mobium.debug.validate: Validation: comparing the next frame with Mobium and the one after with vanilla…
mobium.debug.unavailable: Only available in a development environment, and not while a validation runs
mobium.settings.type.chests.tooltip: Chests, trapped chests, ender chests and shulker boxes, while closed
mobium.settings.type.signs.tooltip: Signs and hanging signs with their text, while not being edited
mobium.settings.type.skulls.tooltip: Skulls and heads (a powered dragon head stays vanilla)
mobium.settings.type.shelves.tooltip: Shelves and the items on them, unless an item is animated
mobium.settings.type.item_frames.tooltip: Item frames and glow item frames, while their item and rotation stay the same
mobium.settings.type.armor_stands.toolti: Armor stands, while their pose stays the same
mobium.settings.type.display_entities.to: Item and block display entities, while they do not move
mobium.reason.failed.tooltip: Switched off for this session after an error: %s. Vanilla draws instead; details are in the log.
mobium.reason.global_switch.tooltip: The Mobium switch below is off.
mobium.reason.ab_toggle.tooltip: Switched off with the A/B key (%s) until it is pressed again (not saved). Rebind it in Controls → Key Binds → Mobium.
mobium.reason.config.tooltip: The module's own switch below is off.
mobium.reason.overlap.tooltip: %s is installed and does the same job, so this module stays off.
mobium.reason.backend.tooltip: Needs the OpenGL backend; %s is active. Vulkan support comes later.
mobium.reason.no_compute.tooltip: The graphics driver does not offer compute shaders (OpenGL 4.3), which this module needs.
mobium.reason.not_built.tooltip: This module is planned but not part of this version.
mobium.settings.status.active.tooltip: Mobium handles what this module covers.
